name: ReadComicOnline Touch
description:
Enhance your reading experience on readcomiconline.li with a touch-friendly UI. This addon provides intuitive touch and click navigation, fullscreen mode, and page bookmarking.

Features:
- Swipe left/right to navigate between pages.
- Single click left/right on the screen to turn pages.
- Single click in the upper third of the screen for page turns with a short delay.
- Double click in the upper third of the screen to toggle fullscreen mode.
- Current page is automatically saved and restored on revisit.
- Dropdown menu to quickly jump to any page.

Usage:
- Swipe left to go to the next page.
- Swipe right to go to the previous page.
- Click on the left side of the screen to go to the previous page.
- Click on the right side of the screen to go to the next page.
- Click in the upper third of the screen for delayed page turns.
- Double click in the upper third of the screen to enter/exit fullscreen mode.
- Use the dropdown menu to select and jump to a specific page.

Enjoy a seamless and enhanced comic reading experience!
